def solve():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
    idx = 0
    message = data[idx].strip()
    idx += 1
    n = int(data[idx].strip())
    idx += 1
    
    operations = []
    for i in range(n):
        operations.append(data[idx].strip())
        idx += 1
    
    # Apply inverse operations in reverse order
    msg = list(message)
    
    for op in reversed(operations):
        parts = op.lower().split()
        
        if parts[0] == 'rotate':
            direction = parts[1]
            k = int(parts[2]) % len(msg) if len(msg) > 0 else 0
            # Inverse: if original was rotate left k, inverse is rotate right k
            if direction == 'left':
                # rotate right k
                msg = msg[-k:] + msg[:-k] if k > 0 else msg
            else:  # right
                # rotate left k
                msg = msg[k:] + msg[:k] if k > 0 else msg
        
        elif parts[0] == 'swap':
            # swap halves - self inverse
            length = len(msg)
            half = length // 2
            msg = msg[half:] + msg[:half]
        
        elif parts[0] == 'reverse':
            msg = msg[::-1]
        
        elif parts[0] == 'increment':
            new_msg = []
            for c in msg:
                if c.isdigit():
                    new_msg.append(str((int(c) - 1) % 10))
                else:
                    new_msg.append(c)
            msg = new_msg
        
        elif parts[0] == 'decrement':
            new_msg = []
            for c in msg:
                if c.isdigit():
                    new_msg.append(str((int(c) + 1) % 10))
                else:
                    new_msg.append(c)
            msg = new_msg
    
    print(''.join(msg))

solve()
